arguments.command:
cd /tmp && rm -rf fresh && cp -r /work/submit fresh && cd fresh && rm -f planb64 && for flags in "-O2 -g" "-O0" "-O3 -march=native" "-std=c++20 -O2" "-Os -ffunction-sections" "-O2 -fsanitize=undefined" "-O2 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wcast-qual -Wstrict-overflow=5"; do
  make clean >/dev/null 2>&1
  out=$(CXX=g++ CXXFLAGS="$flags" make 2>&1); rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "FLAGS [$flags] BUILD FAILED"; echo "$out" | head -20; else
    ./planb64 build /work/examples/fib.txt /tmp/f.idx && cmp /tmp/f.idx /work/examples/expected.idx && ./planb64 lookup /tmp/f.idx /work/examples/trace.txt batch 3 | cmp - /work/examples/expected.txt && echo "FLAGS [$flags] OK" || echo "FLAGS [$flags] RUN FAILED"
  fi
done
